meta.title: DeepSeek Chat
meta.description: Adds a chat.deepseek.com panel to the sidebar, a configurable conversation-header tab (default "DeepSeek Chat"), and an optional right-sidebar card registered through dsh-better-sidebar when installed (default "DeepSeek Chat", independently toggleable and renameable): fills the whole conversation area, remembers the last conversation, keeps a stable login session, and offers a settings page to toggle/rename both surfaces, show plugin metadata (version, author, description, license, npm/GitHub links), and check for updates against npm/GitHub — pure web chat with no account status strip.
